head: Doxology Way prayer app: daily prayers for five Christian traditions
dek: Doxology Way is a $9.99 daily prayer app that follows the prayers, readings and saints of the tradition you pick: Orthodox, Catholic, Anglican, Lutheran or Protestant and Evangelical. It was #55 among paid Reference apps on the US App Store on 21 November.
details: It includes the full Bible with the Apocrypha in several English translations, searchable offline, the day's readings with comments from early Church Fathers, about 2,000 short entries on saints, and a church calendar with fast days. There's a private prayer journal and reminders. It's a one-time purchase with no subscription, no account and no ads, and the developer reports no data collected. Doxology LLC released it on 8 November.
where: iPhone and iPad (also Apple silicon Macs), App Store, $9.99 one-time
means: If you pray the daily offices, this app puts your tradition's prayers and readings in one place without a subscription and works without a connection.
todo: Check which translations and offices your tradition gets on the App Store page before you pay.
